purpose: P0-M3-R2 Apple-like redesign adversarial fixture index (Issue #6 PM PRODUCT DIRECTION UPDATE). Metadata-only (no audio bytes, no copyrighted material). fixtures.json holds timing/preservation fixtures (candidate current-track exit points); pair_fixtures.json holds pair-level mixability/compatibility fixtures. The planner decides WHEN to leave the current track and, separately, WHICH transition class is appropriate given pair compatibility -- never conflating the two (P3/P4).

spec_letter_coverage.description: normal 3-4 min track, technical mix point ~30s, no legitimate exit -> reject
7-minute song, technically attractive candidate ~2 minutes -> catastrophic reject
same 7-minute song, good near-end window in final ~tens of seconds -> accept
same long song with TWO valid near-end windows; later/stronger wins, order-invariant
8-10 minute long song -> fixed-seconds-only rule fails; normalized/structural planner still works
compatible genre + compatible tempo + stable beat -> complex dynamic mix eligible
strongly incompatible genre/style pair -> dynamic mix downgraded/disabled
tempo relation requiring excessive time stretch -> dynamic mix downgraded/disabled
genre/tempo compatible but dense vocal-on-vocal overlap -> dynamic mix downgraded
strong energy-continuation pair with good structure -> preferred high-energy transition candidate
missing/low analysis confidence -> conservative simple/no-special transition
meaningful outro followed by long dead-air silence -> preserve outro, trim dead air, no false truncation report
sequential album intent -> no forced DJ-style transition

retained_from_prior_pass.description: no clean outro at all (authored absence)
intro/verse/chorus early false opportunity before first chorus completes
instrumental / low-vocal case; mid-track opportunity reachable only by the BALANCED_MIX research control, never the default
dense single-track vocal collision case (contrast with pair-level PAIR-04/J)
explicit-highlight research-control case; also proves the intent-mismatch guard (R1)

candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_premature_trap: SYNTHETIC_EXACT fixture-design-intent label: this candidate is technically compatible but must never be selected as a real transition under SEAMLESS_FULL_TRACK_DEFAULT or BALANCED_MIX_RESEARCH_CONTROL.
candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_vocal_collision_trap: SYNTHETIC_EXACT: structurally plausible candidate that must be rejected specifically due to vocal_collision_risk=HIGH.
candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_valid_natural_exit: SYNTHETIC_EXACT: a candidate that is an acceptable choice under the product-default engine (region-supported, musical-unit-complete, low vocal risk, and -- as of this redesign -- near-end enough to clear the preservation floor).
candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_preferred_earliest_valid_exit: SYNTHETIC_EXACT, REDEFINED this pass: the single BEST valid candidate a non-greedy ranked planner should select -- historically named for the common case where 'best' and 'earliest-valid' coincided, but TP-12 (letter D) deliberately proves 'best' can be the LATER of two valid candidates. Field name kept for backward compatibility with run_benchmark.py's missed-opportunity metric; semantics are 'preferred', not literally 'earliest'.
candidate_ground_truth_fields.highlight_eligible: SYNTHETIC_EXACT, TP-10 only: marks the candidate that is intentionally structurally sound but preservation-gated, to isolate the HIGHLIGHT_EXPLICIT intent effect from structural evidence.

fixture_level_fields.trailing_dead_air_ms: Optional. Milliseconds of authored non-musical trailing silence after the musical content ends.
fixture_level_fields.trailing_dead_air_is_authored_non_musica: Optional, default false. Only when explicitly true does effective_content_end_ms subtract trailing_dead_air_ms from duration_ms -- an unannotated tail is NEVER silently treated as removable dead air.
fixture_level_fields.sequential_album_intent: Optional, default false. When true, FULL_DJ_BLEND and SHORT_EQ_BLEND are withheld from preferred_transition_class_set regardless of timing/pair-compatibility quality.

pair_fixture_fields.outgoing / incoming: genre_tags + bpm for each side of the pair
pair_fixture_fields.expected_overall_eligible: SYNTHETIC_EXACT test-design label consumed only by build_fixtures.py-style validation / run_benchmark.py reporting, never by policy/compatibility.py itself

note_on_ground_truth_isolation: Ground-truth-only fields (is_premature_trap, is_vocal_collision_trap, is_valid_natural_exit, is_preferred_earliest_valid_exit, highlight_eligible, expected_overall_eligible) are consumed ONLY by run_benchmark.py's scoring/metrics code and verify.py's assertions, never by policy/eligibility.py, policy/policies.py, policy/compatibility.py, or policy/ranking.py's decision logic. This separation is statically asserted by verify.py (AST-based, immune to prose mentions) so no policy can 'see the answer key'.
